newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrie sees 1996 net at 193 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie sees 1996 net at 193 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian conglomerate PT Bakrie & Brothers estimated its 1996 net profit at 193 billion rupiah against 120 billion rupiah in 1995, company officials said on Friday.

"Last year, net profit is estimated at some 193 billion rupiah, while this year we expect to post a net profit of more than 400 billion rupiah including capital gains from the sale of our stake in Indocopper," chairman Aburizal Bakrie said.
The firm said it expected to post a net profit of some 430 billion rupiah in 1998.
Bakrie said earlier the sale of its 49-percent stake in PT Indocopper Investama, would boost its 1997 net by some 135 billion rupiah.
The firm announced in January it had sold its stake in Indocopper, which has a 9.36 percent stake in gold and copper miner PT Freeport Indonesia, for $302.65 million to PT Nusamba Mineral Industri.
Nusamba Mineral is a unit of the Nusamba Group controlled by foundations linked to President Suharto.
